result.summary: The page is generally clean and usable, but there are visible clipping/truncation issues in horizontally scrolling content and a few minor contrast/tap-target concerns.

issues.description: The right-most category chip after “Healthy” is partially cut off at the screen edge, making the filter row feel broken or overly cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding, a fade/scroll indicator, or ensure the final visible chip is not clipped unless clearly part of a carousel.

issues.description: In “Fastest near you,” the third restaurant card is cut off at the right edge and its name is truncated (“Trattoria Piccol…”), reducing readability.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent card widths, ellipsis only within fully visible cards, and/or add an edge fade to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: Search placeholder text (“Restaurants, dishes, groceries”) is light gray and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast or use a darker secondary text color while preserving placeholder styling.

issues.description: The notification bell’s red badge is very small and may be easy to miss or difficult to perceive.
issues.suggestion: Increase badge size slightly and ensure it has sufficient contrast and an accessible label for the notification state.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card is heavily cropped by the bottom of the viewport, showing only the top of the pizza image with no context.
issues.suggestion: Adjust section spacing or card peek height so the next item is hinted without appearing abruptly sliced.
